# Voice test recordings

Real human pronunciations used by `tests/test_level3_upgrade.py` to check wake-word
("hello") and stop-word ("done") detection, and that similar-sounding words do not
trigger it. Files starting with `neg_` must not trigger either word.

`tests/test_wake_word_emma.py` uses the `emma_` files (the wake word since 2026-09-17) and the
`emmaneg_` files, words that sound like "Emma" and must not trigger it.

All recordings come from [Lingua Libre](https://lingualibre.org) via Wikimedia Commons and
are licensed [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) by the speaker
named in each original file title. They are used unmodified (renamed only).
